compositionRule: Do not clone the Ordinary. Compose canonical graph + form delta + Proper + overlays/following actions.

rules: Inherit the selected Mass form except where an explicit REQ record overrides it.
Gloria, Credo and Alleluia are suppressed as appointed by the Requiem branch.
Use the Requiem Agnus without ordinary breast-strike propagation.
Omit the ordinary peace prayer/Pax and final blessing.
Do not duplicate or renumber canonical Mass identity.
Suppress the Last Gospel only when the Absolution actually follows.
Faithful posture remains LOCAL_OR_INHERIT where no universal lay posture is sourced.
Celebrant aspersion/incensation never propagates to the faithful.

VOTIVE_PROPER.selectionRule: Explicit actual celebration may override the calendar default before Mass starts.
VOTIVE_PROPER.failureRule: Missing requested same-language Proper text fails closed; never substitute Latin prose as vernacular.

rules: Minister kneeling is actor-scoped and never copied to the congregation.
Faithful Sign of Cross is triggered by ACTUALLY_SPRINKLED personal state.
Handoff to ordinary Mass does not suppress the Prayers at the Foot.

PALM.entryRule: If the Palm rite/procession immediately precedes Mass, enter Mass at the Introit.

ASH.entryRule: If ashes immediately precede Mass, enter Mass at the Introit; calendar date alone does not suppress the ordinary opening.

CANDLEMAS.entryRule: If the rite/procession immediately precedes Mass, enter Mass at the Introit and retain candle object state where prescribed.

rules: No ordinary blessing or Last Gospel in the Holy Thursday branch.
Mandatum remains a separate optional actor-scoped insertion.

GOOD_FRIDAY.rule: Never run ordinary Mass assumptions, Canon, bells or dismissal through this graph.

EASTER_VIGIL.rule: The Mass emerges from the Vigil with its own omissions/state resets; Lauds follows the Mass.

rules: Corpus Christi date alone never activates the procession.
When selected: Benedicamus Domino ending; suppress final blessing and Last Gospel.
The procession is sacramental-state driven, not inferred from chant position.

practice.rule: Practice modes consume canonical event IDs and actor topology; they never create a second ceremonial database.
